description: This is a shell script designed to test the behavior of a git HTTP backend with respect to the CONTENT_LENGTH header, including various scenarios such as gzip encoding, truncation, empty bodies, and overflow conditions.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response status; confirms absence of fatal errors and compares actual status with expected.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables and invokes the test Perl script to simulate HTTP requests for the git backend.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Calculates a size that overflows ssize_t to test handling of content length overflow.
